The requested document is loaded by the route identifier and then mapped to its root document.
The owner-aware view_document permission check is applied to the root document, with failure producing an HTTP forbidden response.
Defines owner-aware authorization: access succeeds for an unowned object, an object owned by the user, or an object carrying the requested object permission.
